kind: Independent content-free quality review of fixed 94-case paced remainder

method.calls: 11 independent 94-case run-index evaluations, warmup index 0 separate; additionally each family separately within each run index. Never one 1034-case evaluator call.
method.originalContent: All complete unique reference/hypothesis pairs reread. Existing identical clean-anchor judgments reused exactly with hashes; numbers, negations, names, clause loss/duplication and extras remain distinct from orthographic WER.
method.metadataScope: Actual result files, all metadata files, command logs and per-case completions hashed against recorded per-case bindings; metadata input/parameter/session identity checked. Complete timing/policy/resource structural validation is the parent report, not this quality report. Metadata model ID/hash and sourceRevision also match the frozen source/model for every case.
method.distinctPairCountExplanation: 94 input-case pairs, but only 79 distinct full reference/hypothesis text pairs because quiet variants, empty controls and repeated text share pairs; no additional lexical coverage from 11 repetitions.
method.all94GroupingLimit: all94NumericOnly is the required 94-case evaluator invocation and retains its mechanical mixed-family groups for reproducibility only. Interpret separateFamilies; do not present mixed-family groups as corpus qualification.

limits: No new ASR, reference/audio/parameter changes or normalizer changes.
Five supplement cases include synthetic speech; four calibration role cases are not held-out acceptance.
Historical high-mask 300-second failure and controlled 300-second local errors remain failures despite completed runtime rows.
No new listening, acoustic alignment, inner decoder cause, microphone, P05/P06, L or universal memory qualification.
No blanket zero-name-spelling rule; actual entity loss, semantic substitution and unclear identity retain the historical judgments.
Unweighted Full90 reconstruction uses one actual measured output per original case, not940+180 repetitions; no scope or denominator alteration.
No added natural-monologue, blanket-listening or universal zero-name/word-error requirement. Artificial fixtures may satisfy the fixed duration/energy contract.

canonicalFull90Reconstruction.kind: One actual measured hypothesis per original case; unweighted reconstruction, not a new ASR run
canonicalFull90Reconstruction.rawSelection: Remainder measured-001; central first non-warmup occurrence per fixture; all within-fixture occurrences text/status identical. Original acceptance-v1 case order.

controlled300ContractReadback.meaning: Satisfies fixed 300-second input and no below-threshold energy window for the frozen gate. No new requirement that the case be a natural monologue. No claim of arbitrary future pause-detector behavior.

fixedCleanAnchorCriticalNegationNumberNe.basis: 142 remaining original inventory anchors plus16 central anchors; identical to historical158 judgments. Challenging mask errors are separately reported.

shortSpeechA07bAndLegitimateTextA22.limits: Human digit8/9 cases and synthetic Ja/Nein/thanks; no general waveform or recipient/end-to-end claim.

maximumDurationNoSafeEnergyPause.basis: Actual4.8M PCMframes and all15k energy windows recomputed;21 full source blocks recognizable once in output, local errors retained. Artificial composition is not itself a failed plan gate.

overallP05.remainingEvidenceScope: P05 additionally requires bounded resource/ownership, cancellation, reproducibility and qualified reference configuration evidence. Those are separate structural reports, not newly declared missing or failed by this review. No native recipient/P02/P07 acceptance is added as a P05 gate.

p05GateInterpretation.performance: Stop-to-text threshold belongs to P06; no P05 rejection inferred from central medians over1s.
